cards.name: Supreme Overlord
cards.text: You may return a minion to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Invader
cards.text: Gain 1 VP.

cards.name: Scout
cards.text: Special: After this base scores, you may return this minion to your hand.

cards.name: Collector
cards.text: You may return a minion of power 3 or less on this base to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Abduction
cards.text: Return a minion to its owner's hand. Play an extra minion.

cards.name: Beam Up
cards.text: Return a minion to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Crop Circles
cards.text: Choose a base. Return each minion on that base to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Disintegrator
cards.text: Place a minion of power 3 or less on the bottom of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Invasion
cards.text: Move a minion to another base.

cards.name: Jammed Signal
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: This base's abilities are cancelled.

cards.name: Probe
cards.text: Look at another player's hand and choose a minion in it. That player discards that minion.

cards.name: Terraforming
cards.text: Search the base deck for a base and swap it with a base in play. You may play an extra minion there.

cards.name: The Homeworld
cards.text: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may play an extra minion of power 2 or less.

cards.name: The Mothership
cards.text: After this base scores, the winner may return one of his or her minions of power 3 or less from here to hand.

cards.name: General Ivan
cards.text: Your minions cannot be destroyed. Once per turn, after another player's minion moves, you may give your minions there +1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Polar Commando
cards.text: Place a +1 power counter on this minion or a minion with less power than this minion.

cards.name: Grizzled Veteran
cards.text: You may move another player's minion from here to another base.

cards.name: Cub Scout
cards.text: After another player's minion moves here, if it has less power than this minion, you may destroy it. If you do, you may move one of your minions of printed power 3 or less to this base.

cards.name: Bear Hug
cards.text: Each other player destroys their minion with the least power (controller chooses in case of ties).

cards.name: Bear Necessities
cards.text: Play on a base. Until the start of your turn, other players with a minion here cannot play extra cards. At the start of your next turn, destroy this action.

cards.name: Bear Rides You
cards.text: Move a minion. If you moved a minion you control, you may cancel the abilities of a card at its new base until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Bearing Down
cards.text: Play on a base. This base's breakpoint is increased by 2 for each player with a minion here, or decreased instead if you have moved another player's minion to this base this turn.

cards.name: Commission
cards.text: Play an extra minion immediately. You may move another player's minion from the extra minion's base to another base.

cards.name: High Ground
cards.text: Play on a base. If you have a minion here, after another player's minion moves to this base, you may destroy this action to either destroy that minion OR to draw a card and play an action.

cards.name: Superiority
cards.text: Play on a base. If you have the most power here, either draw a card OR your minions here cannot be affected by other players' cards until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: You're Pretty Much Borscht
cards.text: Choose a base where you have a minion. Move all other players' minions from there to one other base.

cards.name: Field of Honor
cards.text: After the first time you destroy another player's minion here each turn, gain 1 VP.

cards.name: Tsar's Palace
cards.text: If you do not have more power here than each other player, you cannot play minions here of power 2 or less.

cards.name: Major Ursa
cards.text: After another player's minion moves to or from this base, you may place a +1 power counter on this titan. Place a +1 power counter on a minion here OR move this titan.

cards.name: Leader Two
cards.text: One of your other minions gains +2 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Solarshout
cards.text: Talent: Play an extra action. Give this minion -2 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Bruiser
cards.text: Ongoing: This minion cannot be destroyed. Talent: This minion gains +2 power and loses its Ongoing ability and all other abilities until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Huffie
cards.text: Talent: Move this minion to another base and give it -1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Cesium Armor
cards.text: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion has +2 power and cannot be destroyed.

cards.name: Change Into A Gun
cards.text: Play on one of your minions to destroy a minion of power 4 or less there. Ongoing: This minion has -2 power. Destroy this card at the start of your turn.

cards.name: Change Up and Roll On
cards.text: Special: Before a base scores you may move any number of your minions to there. They each get -1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Flighterizer
cards.text: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: 'Talent: Move this minion to another base and give it -1 power until the end of the turn.'

cards.name: Form Mergacon
cards.text: Choose a base. Each of your minions there gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Matrix of Bossiness
cards.text: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: This minion's printed power is treated as if it were 5.

cards.name: Passengers
cards.text: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: 'Talent: If this minion moved this turn, move another one of your minions from the previous base to here.'

cards.name: The Touch
cards.text: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: This minion has the ability: 'Talent: This minion gains +3 power and loses all other abilities until the end of the turn.'

cards.name: Changing Room
cards.text: After a minion here uses a talent, it gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Unicrave
cards.text: Before this base scores, replace it with the top card of the base deck. Keep all cards on it, discard this card, and keep scoring.

cards.name: Mergacon
cards.text: Special: At the start of your turn, if you have two or more minions on a base, you may play this titan there. Ongoing: You have +3 power here. Talent: Move this titan to another base. It loses its ongoing ability until the end of the turn.

cards.name: King Rex
cards.text: No ability.

cards.name: Laseratops
cards.text: You may destroy a minion here of printed power 2 or less.

cards.name: Armor Stego
cards.text: Talent: Until the start of your turn, this minion has +2 power during other players' turns.

cards.name: War Raptor
cards.text: Ongoing: Gains +1 power for each War Raptor on this base (including this one).

cards.name: Augmentation
cards.text: One minion gains +4 power until the end of your turn.

cards.name: Howl
cards.text: Each of your minions gains +1 power until the end of your turn.

cards.name: Natural Selection
cards.text: Choose one of your minions on a base. Destroy a minion there with less power than yours.

cards.name: Rampage
cards.text: Reduce the breakpoint of a base by the power of one of your minions on that base until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Survival of the Fittest
cards.text: Destroy the lowest-power minion (you choose in case of a tie) on each base with a higher-power minion.

cards.name: Tooth and Claw...and Guns
cards.text: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion is not affected by other players' cards.

cards.name: Upgrade
cards.text: Play on a minion. Ongoing: This minion has +2 power.

cards.name: Wildlife Preserve
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here are not affected by other players' actions.

cards.name: Tar Pits
cards.text: When a minion here would be destroyed for the first time each turn, place it on the bottom of its owner's deck instead.

cards.name: Titania
cards.text: Return an opponent's minion to its owner's hand, OR play an extra minion.

cards.name: Glymmer
cards.text: Talent: Until the start of your next turn, either another minion has -4 power (minimum 0), OR this minion has +1 power.

cards.name: Puck
cards.text: Play an extra action OR draw a card.

cards.name: Tinx
cards.text: You may transfer an action played on another minion to this one.

cards.name: Daisy Chain
cards.text: Play on minion. Ongoing: If you control it, it has +2 power, otherwise -2 power.

cards.name: Enchantment
cards.text: Play on base and choose: Ongoing all minions here have +1 power OR all have -1 power.

cards.name: Fairy Ballet
cards.text: Draw two cards, OR draw a card and play an extra action.

cards.name: Ladybug
cards.text: Play on minion. Ongoing: cannot be destroyed. Talent: Transfer to another minion.

cards.name: Leaf Armor
cards.text: Play on minion. Ongoing: minion gains ability 'Talent: +2 power until end of turn.'

cards.name: Magic Acorns
cards.text: Each other player discards randomly, OR you draw and play an extra action.

cards.name: Magic Ward
cards.text: Play on base. Ongoing: Other players cannot play actions here or on minions.

cards.name: Playful Tricks
cards.text: Destroy up to 2 actions on minions/bases OR play Spirit of the Forest.

cards.name: Fairy Circle
cards.text: After first minion play each turn, play extra minion or action.

cards.name: Enchanted Glen
cards.text: After playing action on minion here, draw a card.

cards.name: Spectre
cards.text: If you have 2 or fewer cards in your hand, any time you can play a minion, you can play this card from your discard pile instead.

cards.name: Haunting
cards.text: If you have two or fewer cards in your hand, this minion has +3 power and is not affected by other players' cards.

cards.name: Spirit
cards.text: Choose a minion. You may discard cards equal to its power to destroy it.

cards.name: Ghost
cards.text: You may discard a card from your hand.

cards.name: Across the Divide
cards.text: Place any number of minions with that name from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Door to the Beyond
cards.text: Ongoing: If you have two or fewer cards in your hand, each of your minions here has +2 power.

cards.name: Ghostly Arrival
cards.text: You may play an extra minion and/or an extra action.

cards.name: Incorporeal
cards.text: This minion is not affected by other players' cards.

cards.name: Make Contact
cards.text: Minion control card with conditional destruction based on hand size.

cards.name: Séance
cards.text: If you have 2 or fewer cards in your hand, draw until you have 5 cards.

cards.name: Shady Deal
cards.text: If you have two or fewer cards in your hand, gain 1 VP.

cards.name: The Dead Rise
cards.text: Discard any number of cards. Play an extra minion from your discard pile with power less than the number of cards you discarded.

cards.name: Haunted House
cards.text: Forces discard after minion plays.

cards.name: The Dread Gazebo
cards.text: Prevents action plays.

cards.name: Killer Queen
cards.text: Talent: Draw a minion of power 1 or less off the top of your deck OR choose another minion you played this turn and place a +1 power counter on this minion and that minion.

cards.name: Drone
cards.text: Place a +1 power counter on this minion. Ongoing: When one of your minions would be destroyed, you may remove a +1 power counter from this minion instead. Talent: Remove a +1 power counter from this minion to draw a card.

cards.name: Soldier
cards.text: Place two +1 power counters on this minion. Talent: Transfer a +1 power counter between two of your minions.

cards.name: Worker
cards.text: Place two +1 power counters on this minion. Ongoing: After this minion goes to the discard pile from play, if it had no +1 power counters on it, you may play it on another base.

cards.name: A Kind of Magic
cards.text: Transfer any number of +1 power counters between your cards.

cards.name: Gimme the Prize
cards.text: Place two +1 power counters on a minion and a +1 power counter on another minion.

cards.name: Headlong
cards.text: Move one of your minions to another base. Place two +1 power counters on that minion.

cards.name: The Show Must Go On
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here with +1 power counters are not affected by other players' cards.

cards.name: Under Pressure
cards.text: Special: Before a base scores, transfer any number of +1 power counters from one of your minions to another minion.

cards.name: We Are the Champions
cards.text: Special: After a base scores, transfer any number of +1 power counters from one of your minions there to another minion.

cards.name: We Will Rock You
cards.text: Each of your minions on one base gain +1 power until the end of the turn for each +1 power counter on them.

cards.name: Who Wants to Live Forever?
cards.text: Destroy one of your minions. Search your deck for a card and place it on top of your deck without revealing it.

cards.name: The Hill
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may move one of your minions to this base.

cards.name: Egg Chamber
cards.text: Minions here with +1 power counters cannot be destroyed.

cards.name: The Locals
cards.text: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Place any The Locals revealed into your hand. Put the rest of the cards on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: In Plain Sight
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here of printed power 2 or less are not affected by opponents' cards.

cards.name: Mysteries of the Deep
cards.text: If you have three or more minions with the same name on a base, draw 3 cards, then you may draw 2 additional cards and 2 Madness cards.

cards.name: New Acolytes
cards.text: All players shuffle all minions in their discard piles into their decks.

cards.name: Recruitment
cards.text: Draw up to three Madness cards. For each one drawn, you may play an extra minion this turn.

cards.name: Return to the Sea
cards.text: Special: After a base scores, return any number of your minions with the same name on that base to your hand.

cards.name: Sacred Circle
cards.text: Play on a base. Talent: You may play an extra minion here with the same name as another minion here.

cards.name: Spreading the Word
cards.text: Play up to two extra minions with the same name as a minion in play.

cards.name: The Deep Ones
cards.text: Each of your minions of power 2 or less get +1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Innsmouth
cards.text: After each time a minion is played here, its owner may place one card from any player's discard pile on the bottom of their deck.

cards.name: Ritual Site
cards.text: After this base scores, all minions on it are shuffled into their owners' decks.

cards.name: Dagon
cards.text: Special: On your turn, you may play this titan on a base where you have two or more minions with the same name. Ongoing: You have +1 power here for each of your minions here that has the same name as another minion here. Talent: Play an extra minion here.

cards.name: Kaijookey
cards.text: Ongoing: This minion has +1 power for each of your actions played on this base.

cards.name: Tiny Priestesses
cards.text: Play or move Gorgodzolla to here.

cards.name: Johnny
cards.text: You may return one of your actions on a base to your hand and play it here as an extra action.

cards.name: Kaiju Alliance
cards.text: Reduce the breakpoint of all bases by 4 until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Kaiju Conflict
cards.text: Play two extra actions.

cards.name: Oh, No!
cards.text: Play on a base. Play or move Gorgodzolla to here. Ongoing: You gain +2 power here.

cards.name: Pick Up a Bus
cards.text: Choose an action in your discard pile that can be played on a base and place it into your hand.

cards.name: Radioactive Breath
cards.text: Play on a base. Destroy any number of minions here of power 2 or less. Ongoing: You gain +3 power here.

cards.name: Stomp
cards.text: Play on a base. Reduce its breakpoint by 3 until the end of the turn. Ongoing: You gain +2 power here.

cards.name: Tail Smash
cards.text: Play on a base. Destroy a minion you don't control here of power 3 or less. Ongoing: You gain +4 power here.

cards.name: The Folly of Men
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions and other actions on this base cannot be destroyed by other players' cards. You gain +2 power here.

cards.name: There Goes Tokyo
cards.text: If Gorgodzolla is in play, destroy its base. Move Gorgodzolla to another base and replace the destroyed base normally.

cards.name: They Say He's Got to Go
cards.text: Move a titan to another base.

cards.name: Wade Through the Buildings
cards.text: Play on a base. Destroy all other players' actions on this base. Ongoing: You gain +4 power here.

cards.name: Kaiju Island
cards.text: Titans here do not make other titans leave. Each titan here adds +3 power to its controller's power here.

cards.name: Tokyo
cards.text: After you play an action on this base, you gain +3 power here until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Gorgodzolla
cards.text: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this card on a base where you have two or more actions. Ongoing: After you play an action or a minion on this base, place a +1 power counter on this card. Ongoing: After you play an action on this base, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Venus Man Trap
cards.text: Search your deck for a minion of power 2 or less and play it here as an extra minion. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Weed Eater
cards.text: At the start of your turn, this minion gains +2 power until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Water Lily
cards.text: Draw a card at the start of each of your turns. Only use one Water Lily's ability each turn.

cards.name: Sprout
cards.text: Destroy this card at the start of your turn. You may search your deck for a minion of power 3 or less, play it here as an extra minion, and shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Blossom
cards.text: Play up to three extra minions that all have the same name.

cards.name: Budding
cards.text: Choose a minion in play. Search your deck for a copy of that card and place it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Choking Vines
cards.text: Play on a minion. At the start of your turn, destroy this minion.

cards.name: Deep Roots
cards.text: Play on a base. Your minions here cannot be moved or returned to your hand by other players' abilities.

cards.name: Entangled
cards.text: Play on a base. Minions may not be moved or returned to hands from any base where you have a minion. Destroy this card at the start of your turn.

cards.name: Insta-Grow
cards.text: Play an extra minion.

cards.name: Sleep Spores
cards.text: Play on a base. Other players' minions have -1 power here (minimum power 0).

cards.name: Secret Grove
cards.text: On your turn, you may play one extra minion of power 2 or less here.

cards.name: The Greenhouse
cards.text: After this base scores and is replaced, the winner may search their deck for a minion and play it on the replacement base.

cards.name: Herr Doktor
cards.text: Talent: Place a +1 power counter on another one of your minions.

cards.name: The Monster
cards.text: Talent: Remove a +1 power counter from this minion to play an extra minion.

cards.name: Lab Assistant
cards.text: Place a +1 power counter on another one of your minions.

cards.name: Igor
cards.text: Ongoing: After this minion is destroyed or discarded, place a +1 power counter on one of your minions.

cards.name: Angry Mob
cards.text: Choose one of your minions. Place any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck. For each card placed, add a +1 power counter on that minion.

cards.name: Blitzed
cards.text: Remove any number of +1 power counters from your minions. Destroy a minion with power less than or equal to the number of counters removed.

cards.name: Body Shop
cards.text: Destroy one of your minions. Place +1 power counters equal to that minion's power, split any way you choose, on your minions.

cards.name: German Engineering
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: After you play a minion here, place a +1 power counter on it.

cards.name: Grave Situation
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: If your minions here would be destroyed, return them to your hand instead.

cards.name: IT'S ALIVE!
cards.text: Play an extra minion. Place a +1 power counter on it.

cards.name: Jolt
cards.text: Place a +1 power counter on each of your minions.

cards.name: Überserum
cards.text: Play on a minion. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, place a +1 power counter on this minion. This minion cannot be destroyed.

cards.name: Golem Schloß
cards.text: After this base scores, the winner places a +1 power counter on each of their minions.

cards.name: Laboratorium
cards.text: After the first time each turn a minion is played here, its controller places a +1 power counter on it.

cards.name: Lunar Captain
cards.text: Talent: Choose a minion in your discard pile with power less than or equal to the number of your minions here, and place it into your hand.

cards.name: Sakura Warrior
cards.text: Talent: Reduce a minion's power here by the number of your minions here until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Technomagical Lass
cards.text: Talent: Destroy a minion you don't control here with power less than or equal to the number of your minions here.

cards.name: Bewitching Gal
cards.text: Talent: Reduce the breakpoint of this base by the number of your minions here until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Fancy Suit Lad
cards.text: Ongoing: Your other minions here are not affected by other players' cards.

cards.name: Power Maid
cards.text: Talent: Choose a minion with power less than or equal to the number of your minions here, and move it to or from here.

cards.name: Black Magicat
cards.text: Search your deck and/or discard pile for Lunar Captain and place it into your hand.

cards.name: White Magicat
cards.text: Search your deck and/or discard pile for Power Maid and place it into your hand.

cards.name: Rainbow Girl
cards.text: Your other minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Celestial Teleport
cards.text: Play on one of your minions. Talent: Move this minion to another base.

cards.name: Coordination
cards.text: Play either an extra minion or Walking Castle.

cards.name: Coronet Attack
cards.text: Destroy a minion you don't control with power less than or equal to the number of your minions at the same base.

cards.name: Kiss the Sky Spell
cards.text: Place a minion from your discard pile into your hand. You may play an extra action this turn.

cards.name: Lunar Healing Love Spell
cards.text: Choose a minion in each player's discard pile and place it into its owner's hand.

cards.name: Magical Staff
cards.text: Play on your minion. Ongoing: This minion gains +1 power. When this minion goes to the discard pile, place it on top of your deck instead.

cards.name: Purge the Demon
cards.text: Choose a card. Destroy an action on it, OR remove all counters on it.

cards.name: Silver Shard
cards.text: All players shuffle all minions in their discard piles into their decks.

cards.name: Akihabara High
cards.text: After you play a minion here, your other minions here gain +1 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Q Point
cards.text: Before this base scores, each player destroys all of their minions and actions on this base but one card total.

cards.name: Walking Castle
cards.text: Play on a base where you have at least two minions. Ongoing: Your minions here cannot be destroyed by other players' abilities. Talent: Move this titan and up to three of your minions here to another base.

cards.name: Star-Spawn of Cthulhu
cards.text: Talent: Place a Madness card from your hand into another player's hand.

cards.name: Cthulhu's Chosen
cards.text: Special: Before a base scores, you may draw a Madness card to give this minion +2 power until the end of the turn.

cards.name: Servitor of Cthulhu
cards.text: Destroy this minion and place an action card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.name: Altar to Cthulhu
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: Once per turn, after you play a minion here, you may play an extra action.

cards.name: Complete the Ritual
cards.text: Play on a base where you have at least one minion. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, place all cards here on the bottom of their owners' decks and swap this base with the top card.

cards.name: Corruption
cards.text: Draw a Madness card. Destroy a minion.

cards.name: Cthulhu Fhtagn
cards.text: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you have revealed two actions. Place them into your hand and put the rest on the bottom.

cards.name: Furthering the Cause
cards.text: Play on a base. Ongoing: At the end of every turn, if another player's minion here was destroyed, gain 1 VP.

cards.name: It Begins Again
cards.text: Shuffle any number of actions from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.name: Madness Unleashed
cards.text: Discard any number of Madness cards. For each one discarded, you may draw a card and play an extra action this turn.

cards.name: Recruit by Force
cards.text: Place any number of minions of power 3 or less from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.name: The Seal is Broken
cards.text: Draw a Madness card. Gain 1 VP.

cards.name: Whispers in Darkness
cards.text: Draw a Madness card. You may play two extra actions this turn.

cards.name: Mountains of Madness
cards.text: After each time a minion is played here, its owner draws a Madness card.

cards.name: R'lyeh
cards.text: At the start of each player's turn, that player may destroy one of their minions here. If they do, they gain 1 VP.

cards.name: Cthulhu
cards.text: Special: Instead of your regular action play, draw two Madness cards to play this titan on a base with one of your minions. Ongoing: After you play or draw a Madness card place a +1 power counter on this titan. Talent: Draw a Madness card, OR place a Madness card from your hand into another player's hand.

cards.name: Professor
cards.text: Discard a Madness card. If you do, you may play an extra action and/or an extra minion.

cards.name: Librarian
cards.text: Draw a Madness card OR play a Madness card from your hand as an extra action.

cards.name: Psychologist
cards.text: Return a Madness card from your hand or discard pile to the Madness deck OR draw a Madness card from your discard pile.

cards.name: Researcher
cards.text: Effect involves Madness cards and card draw (text not fully confirmed from source).

cards.name: "Old Man Jenkins?"
cards.text: Before a base scores, destroy a minion with the highest power there.

cards.name: Field Trip
cards.text: Place any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck to draw that number plus one cards.

cards.name: Eldritch Gate
cards.text: Play on a base. Talent: Draw a Madness card. You may play an extra minion here.

cards.name: Jinkies!
cards.text: Return up to two Madness cards from your hand and/or discard pile to the Madness deck.

cards.name: That's So Crazy...
cards.text: Draw a Madness card. Each of your minions gains +1 power until end of turn. You may play an extra action.

cards.name: ...It Just Might Work
cards.text: Discard up to two Madness cards to give your minions +1 power until end of turn for each.

cards.name: Things Best Not Known
cards.text: Before a base scores, draw up to three Madness cards. Give a minion there +2 power per card drawn until end of turn.

cards.name: Those Meddling Kids
cards.text: Destroy any number of actions on a single base OR draw a Madness card and play an extra action.

cards.name: Ninja Master
cards.text: You may destroy a minion on this base.

cards.name: Tiger Assassin
cards.text: You may destroy a minion of power 3 or less on this base.
